title: Affiliate Disclosure
body: Semiconductores.net may include affiliate links to component distributors and course providers. If you click one and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you. Affiliate relationships never influence our technical information, specifications, or recommendations — engineering facts come from manufacturer datasheets and are independent of any commercial relationship. All affiliate destinations are managed through a single internal configuration, and we only activate a program after we are accepted into it and have reviewed its terms.
